'''Dorsil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Dorsil was among the many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Dorsil was a merchant who traded specialty goods with visitors and citizens of Kalikori.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dorsil was removed from the game in update 6.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 6.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1292020/game-update-6.2|text=Game Update 6.2}}</ref> He was later brought back to the game in update 7.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 7.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/08022022/game-update-7.1-digging-deeper|text=Game Update 7.1: Digging Deeper Patch Notes}}</ref>
